Out Of Rs. 1.19 crores for A.Y. 2015-16, demand for Rs. 0.75 crores is on account of errors in tax calculations by the Income Tax Department which will be rectified in due course. The Company is of the opinion that the remaining demands are not tenable and has filed appeal against them with Commissioner of Income Tax (appeals). An appeal has been filed in Bombay High Court by

The Company has disputed liability of Rs. 3.32 crores (For F.Y. 2022-23 it was Rs. 3.32
crores) in respect of Customs duty raised by Commissioner of Customs. In respect of the demand raised by Commissioner of Customs, the Company is of the opinion that the demand is not tenable and has made appropriate submission to the department. The Company has received stay order form Gujarat High Court against the demand of Custom Duty.
The Company has given Corporate guarantee of Rs. 85.58 crores (For F.Y. 2023-24 it was Rs. 83.37 crores) to Banks for facilities availed by its subsidiary company.

c)	The Company has disputed Income tax liability of Rs. 0.75 crores for A.Y. 2015-16. This demand is because of errors in tax calculations by the Income Tax Department, which will be rectified in due course. An appeal has been filed in Bombay High Court by the Income Tax Department against the order of ITAT passed in favour of the Company including tax demand of Rs.9.53 crore for AY 12-13 and Rs.1.87 crore for AY 17-18.

The Company has disputed liability of Rs. 3.32 crores (For F.Y. 2022-23 it was Rs. 3.32
crores) in respect of Customs duty raised by Commissioner of Customs. In respect of the demand raised by Commissioner of Customs, the Company is of the opinion that the demand is not tenable and has made appropriate submission to the department. The Company has received stay order form Gujarat High Court against the demand of Custom Duty.
